[SWS_DM_00238] Aging and healing
⌈
If an indicator is configured for
the corresponding event, the process of Aging (counting of Aging counter) shall
be started only after the healing (according to [SWS_DM_00224]) is completed
(’warningIndicatorRequested’ bit is set to 0).
⌋
